story: As an admin, I can sign in and access site-specific administration areas so that operational data stays controlled.
acceptance_summary: OIDC/JWT auth scaffolded; site-aware RBAC guards work in API and UI.

story: As an admin, I can manage users and roles so that staff only see actions they are allowed to perform.
acceptance_summary: Create, activate, deactivate, and role-assign staff users with audit.

story: As front desk, I can find or create a customer in under a minute so repeat visits are fast.
acceptance_summary: Search by phone, plate, name; create customer and vehicle quickly.

story: As front desk, I can attach one or more vehicles to a customer so visit history is accurate.
acceptance_summary: Vehicle CRUD with plate/VIN uniqueness checks.

story: As a service advisor, I can create an appointment that respects duration, technician skill, and bay constraints.
acceptance_summary: Scheduler only offers valid slots and stores requested services.

story: As a customer, I receive confirmation when my booking is created or changed.
acceptance_summary: SMS/email confirmation queued and logged.

story: As a service advisor, I can reschedule without losing customer/vehicle/service context.
acceptance_summary: Original appointment history retained; reschedule event audited.

story: As front desk, I can register a walk-in and issue a queue ticket in a few clicks.
acceptance_summary: Walk-in creation, ticket generation, ETA display, audit.

story: As front desk, I can check in an appointment and apply early/late rules automatically.
acceptance_summary: Grace period and early-arrival behavior implemented from config.

story: As a customer, I can see my ticket and estimated wait so I know what to expect.
acceptance_summary: Customer status view and queue board update in real time.

story: As a manager, I can see the live queue, statuses, and blocked reasons so I can intervene quickly.
acceptance_summary: Live board shows rank, ETA, status, blocked reasons, assigned tech if applicable.

story: As a manager, I can override queue position with a reason when needed.
acceptance_summary: Before/after audit captured with reason codes.

story: As a service advisor, I can create and refine a service order from the requested visit.
acceptance_summary: Job card supports multiple line items, notes, and promised time.

story: As a service advisor, I can assign a qualified technician and bay.
acceptance_summary: Only compatible techs/bays can be selected; no double-booking.

story: As a technician, I can update work status from my queue so the office sees progress instantly.
acceptance_summary: Start, pause, waiting-parts, QC, complete transitions recorded with timestamps.

story: As a manager, I can see utilization and bottlenecks by technician and bay.
acceptance_summary: Operational dashboard metrics computed from actual timestamps.

story: As parts staff, I can see upcoming jobs that need parts so I can stage them before arrival.
acceptance_summary: Next-day parts board with required-by time and readiness flags.

story: As parts staff, I can reserve or transfer critical parts for a job.
acceptance_summary: Parts reservation and transfer workflow with ETA tracking.

story: As a service advisor, I can see whether a job is blocked by parts before promising completion.
acceptance_summary: Parts-ready flags visible in scheduler and service order.

story: As a customer, I receive reminders and delay notifications so I am not left guessing.
acceptance_summary: 24h and 2h reminders, delay alerts, ready-for-pickup notifications.

story: As front desk, I can resend or manually trigger notices when needed.
acceptance_summary: Manual resend with channel history and audit.

story: As transport coordinator, I can schedule customer drop-off and pickup legs around the service lifecycle.
acceptance_summary: Transport request, scheduling, driver assignment, status tracking.

story: As a customer, I can confirm my preferred transport window from a message link.
acceptance_summary: Lightweight confirmation flow with secure token.

story: As a manager, I can track wait time, no-shows, utilization, parts delays, and satisfaction.
acceptance_summary: Dashboard and exportable reports with filters by date/site/service family.

story: As a manager, I can get recurring-maintenance opportunities and reminder suggestions.
acceptance_summary: Return-due list generated from historical visits and service intervals.

story: As a manager, I can view prediction-based no-show risk and duration estimates once enough data exists.
acceptance_summary: Optional analytics module behind feature flag; explainability included.

story: As a manager, I can edit grace period, operating hours, service durations, and templates without developer help.
acceptance_summary: Config UI with validation, versioning, and audit.

story: As an admin, I can view a full audit trail of operational and configuration changes.
acceptance_summary: Audit filter by actor, entity, action, date.
